description: Query supported assets, asset details, and exchange rates from Crypto APIs market data.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Crypto APIs API key sent with the x-api-key header. Create and manage API keys in the Crypto APIs dashboard at https://app.cryptoapis.io/login.

actions.name: get_asset_details_by_id
actions.description: Get detailed Crypto APIs market data for one asset by its Crypto APIs reference ID.

assetId.description: The unique Crypto APIs reference ID for the asset.

context.description: A client-provided context value returned by Crypto APIs to correlate responses with requests.

inputSchema.description: The input for retrieving asset details by reference ID.

apiVersion.description: The Crypto APIs REST API version that handled the request.

requestId.description: The unique request ID generated by Crypto APIs.

context.description: A client-provided context value returned by Crypto APIs to correlate responses with requests.

calculationTimestamp.description: The UNIX timestamp when Crypto APIs calculated the latest rate.

unit.description: The unit of the latest asset price.

latestRate.description: The latest USD-denominated market rate returned for an asset.

encoding.description: The encoding of the image data, usually base64.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the encoded logo image.

logo.description: Encoded asset logo data returned by Crypto APIs.

originalSymbol.description: The asset symbol as introduced by its founders.

referenceId.description: The unique Crypto APIs reference ID for the asset.

slug.description: The asset slug in Crypto APIs listings.

specificData.description: Provider-specific market data for the asset.

symbol.description: The unique asset symbol in Crypto APIs listings.

item.description: Detailed Crypto APIs market data for one asset.

outputSchema.description: The asset details response returned by Crypto APIs.

actions.name: get_exchange_rate_by_asset_ids
actions.description: Get the exchange rate for one Crypto APIs asset reference ID versus another asset reference ID.

fromAssetId.description: The base asset reference ID to get a rate for.

toAssetId.description: The relation asset reference ID in which the base asset rate is displayed.

context.description: A client-provided context value returned by Crypto APIs to correlate responses with requests.

calculationTimestamp.description: The optional UNIX timestamp for historical market data used to calculate the exchange rate. Crypto APIs supports up to 30 days back.

inputSchema.description: The input for retrieving an exchange rate by asset reference IDs.

apiVersion.description: The Crypto APIs REST API version that handled the request.

requestId.description: The unique request ID generated by Crypto APIs.

context.description: A client-provided context value returned by Crypto APIs to correlate responses with requests.

calculationTimestamp.description: The UNIX timestamp for the market data used to calculate the rate.

rate.description: The exchange rate calculated from weighted recent exchange trades.

item.description: A Crypto APIs exchange rate between two assets.

outputSchema.description: The exchange rate response returned by Crypto APIs.
